mapper.select:
WITH RECURSIVE menu_tree AS ( SELECT menu.menu_id, menu.menu_nm, menu.anct_menu_id AS up_menu_id, menu.npag_yn, menu.url_addr, LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(menu.sort_seq, 0) AS VARCHAR),3,'0') as sort_path, CAST(menu.menu_nm AS CHARACTER VARYING) as up_menu_id_nm, menu.menu_use_yn, 1 AS level from cdm_own.menu menu inner join cdm_own.menu_auth authrt on menu.menu_id = authrt.menu_id WHERE (menu.anct_menu_id IS null or menu.anct_menu_id ='') and authrt.auth_cd = #{authrtCd} UNION ALL SELECT menu.menu_id, menu.menu_nm, menu.anct_menu_id AS up_menu_id, menu.npag_yn, menu.url_addr, mt.sort_path || '-' || LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(menu.sort_seq, 1) AS VARCHAR),3,'0') as sort_path, mt.up_menu_id_nm || ' >' || menu.menu_nm as up_menu_id_nm, menu.menu_use_yn, mt.level + 1 AS level FROM cdm_own.menu menu inner join cdm_own.menu_auth authrt on menu.menu_id = authrt.menu_id inner join menu_tree mt ON menu.anct_menu_id = mt.menu_id WHERE authrt.auth_cd = #{authrtCd} ) SELECT menu_nm, menu_id, menu.npag_yn, menu.up_menu_id_nm, menu.url_addr, COALESCE(up_menu_id, '') as up_menu_id, sort_path, level FROM menu_tree menu where COALESCE(menu.menu_use_yn, 'Y') != 'N' and menu.npag_yn != 'X'
AND (menu.menu_id LIKE '%' || #{menuIdOrNm} || '%' OR menu.menu_nm LIKE '%' || #{menuIdOrNm} || '%') /* 메뉴 ID 또는 명 */
order by sort_path
